name: submit_parking_assignment
description: submit_parking_assignment: Submit a parking space assignment for an employee. The space ID must be one confirmed as available. Returns an error if the employee already has an assigned space (already_assigned), or if their previous assignment is less than 180 days old (too_soon — reassignment cooldown).

employee_id.description: The employee being assigned the space (e.g. EMP048271).

parking_space_id.description: The specific parking space ID to assign (e.g. PZA-042).
